name: Cron Calculator
description: Explain any cron expression in plain English, with a field breakdown and the next runs.
longDescription: Explains a cron expression in plain English, with a field breakdown and the next runs in the time zone you pick. Reads standard 5-field cron, seconds-first (Spring, node-cron), Quartz, AWS EventBridge, whole crontab lines, and the schedules in GitHub Actions and Kubernetes files. A visual builder edits one field at a time. Everything happens in the plugin; nothing is uploaded.
